# CAD Importer: tools for AI assistants

<!-- Generated by tools/export-tool-reference.mjs from the running plugin. Do not edit by hand. -->

23 tools, served by the `cad` MCP server 1.1.0 inside the Unreal Editor. An assistant reads the same list from the server itself (`tools/list`); this file is for people.

- Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:47920/mcp` (or the next free port up to 47929). Run `CAD.Mcp` in the Output Log for the URL, the token and the connect command.
- The same tools run from the console: `CAD.Tools` lists them, `CAD.Tool <name> {json}` calls one; and from Blueprint or Python through `CADMcpLibrary`.
- Names are `family_verb`; arguments are camelCase. An answer is a short sentence plus structured JSON; a refusal says what to do instead.

## What the server tells the assistant

```text
CAD Importer brings 2D CAD drawings (DXF, and its own JSON) into the open Unreal level as spline actors, one per entity, tagged with their source drawing and layer and grouped in the outliner under CAD/<file>/<layer>. A 3D toolbox extrudes splines into walls (procedural meshes) and converts them to static meshes. There is no 3D CAD (no STEP, no Datasmith).
Begin with cad_status, then import_list_sources to see what is already imported.
Workflow: 1) import_inspect the file (nothing changes): read its units, bounds, layers, warnings and suspicious findings. 2) import_file with explicit units, layer filters and per-layer materials. 3) layer_list / layer_set for visibility, colours, material mapping and heights. 4) model_generate_walls on wall layers, then model_fix_normals, model_cap_holes, model_smooth, model_to_static_mesh. 5) cleanup_report, then the cleanup_ tool each finding names. 6) viewport_focus and viewport_screenshot to look at the result before telling the user it worked.
Units: Unreal works in centimetres. A DXF declares its units in $INSUNITS, often not at all. When import_inspect reports a confidence other than high, ask the user which units the drawing is in (mm, cm, m, in, ft) before importing; a plan in mm imported as m comes out 1000 times too large. Lengths in answers are in cm with a `text` in m or km: quote the text.
Tools act on what you name (actors, a source, layers), never on the editor selection. Files are read only from inside the project folder (or the plugin's Content/Samples). Tools that change the level are one undo step each (Ctrl+Z). import_delete_source, cleanup_remove_duplicates and cleanup_merge_by_layer are destructive: show the user what will go (cleanup_report, dryRun) and get their confirmation first. New assets from conversions and merges stay unsaved until the user saves.
```

## status

### cad_status

**CAD Importer status**. Reads only: never changes anything.

Start here. Says which Unreal project and level this editor has open, whether a Play-In-Editor session is running, the engine version, and which tool families CAD Importer offers (the part of a tool's name before its first underscore). Read tools/list for the tools themselves.

No arguments.

## cleanup

### cleanup_merge_by_layer

**Merge meshes per layer**. **Destructive**: removes data; the assistant should ask you first.

Merge the walls and static meshes of one imported drawing into one static mesh actor per layer, with the engine's Merge Actors utility (materials kept as sections). 'source' is required; 'layers' narrows it. Fewer actors render and save faster, but each layer becomes one object: confirm with the user. The originals are deleted unless keepOriginals; Ctrl+Z restores them, the new assets stay (unsaved).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Mesh actors to merge: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `assetFolder` | string |  | Content folder for the merged meshes (default /Game/CI_StaticMeshes/Merged/). |
| `convertProcedural` | boolean |  | Convert procedural walls to static meshes first (default true). |
| `keepOriginals` | boolean |  | Keep the actors that were merged (default false: they are deleted). |

### cleanup_remove_duplicates

**Remove duplicate actors**. **Destructive**: removes data; the assistant should ask you first.

Delete actors that duplicate another one in the same place (same class and geometry within tolerance; a line drawn twice in opposite directions counts), keeping the first of each group. Destructive: show the user cleanup_report's duplicates (or run with dryRun=true) and confirm first. Ctrl+Z in the editor restores them.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Actors to check (default: every imported CAD actor): actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `includeLevelStaticMeshes` | boolean |  | Also look at every static mesh actor in the level, imported or not (default false). |
| `tolerance` | number |  | Positions closer than this (cm) count as the same place (default 0.1). |
| `sameLayerOnly` | boolean |  | Only remove copies on the same layer (default true). |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Only list what would be removed (default false). |

### cleanup_rename

**Rename actors by rule**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Give actors labels built from a template (layer, kind, index per group, file, source, old label) with an optional prefix and suffix; labels are kept unique in the level. dryRun defaults to true and only previews: show the preview to the user, then call again with dryRun=false. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Actors to rename: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `template` | string |  | New label: tokens {layer}, {kind}, {index}, {file}, {source}, {label} (default {layer}_{kind}_{index}). |
| `prefix` | string |  | Text before every new label. |
| `suffix` | string |  | Text after every new label. |
| `padding` | integer |  | Digits of {index} (default 3). |
| `startIndex` | integer |  | First {index} of each group (default 1). |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Only preview the new labels (default true). |

### cleanup_report

**Scene hygiene report**. Reads only: never changes anything.

Check imported CAD actors (and optionally every static mesh in the level) without changing anything: duplicates at the same place, degenerate or zero-length splines, tiny meshes, labels used more than once, meshes whose pivot is far from their geometry, empty or default materials, and geometry far from the world origin. Run it after an import and before the other cleanup_ tools; each finding names the tool that fixes it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Actors to check (default: every imported CAD actor): actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `includeLevelStaticMeshes` | boolean |  | Also look at every static mesh actor in the level, imported or not (default false). |
| `tolerance` | number |  | Positions closer than this (cm) count as the same place (default 0.1). |
| `sameLayerOnly` | boolean |  | Only count copies on the same layer as duplicates (default true). |
| `minLength` | number |  | Splines shorter than this (cm) are degenerate (default 0.1). |
| `minMeshSize` | number |  | Meshes whose largest side is under this (cm) are tiny (default 1). |
| `pivotDistance` | number |  | Report meshes whose pivot is further than this (cm) from their geometry (default 1000). |
| `farFromOrigin` | number |  | Report geometry centred further than this (cm) from the origin (default 1000000). |
| `limit` | integer |  | At most this many items per finding (default 50). |

### cleanup_set_collision

**Set mesh collision**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Set collision of converted CAD meshes (or any static mesh actors): whether the components collide, the assets' collision complexity, and their simple collision shape. Typical for walls: complexity complexAsSimple, enabled queryAndPhysics. Only project assets (/Game/) not shared with other components are changed unless allowSharedAssets.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Static mesh actors: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `enabled` | string: `none` / `queryOnly` / `physicsOnly` / `queryAndPhysics` |  | Collision on the components. |
| `complexity` | string: `default` / `simpleAndComplex` / `complexAsSimple` / `simpleAsComplex` |  | Collision complexity of the mesh assets (complexAsSimple: walls collide exactly). |
| `simpleShape` | string: `keep` / `none` / `box` |  | Simple collision of the mesh assets: keep, none, or one box around the mesh. |
| `allowSharedAssets` | boolean |  | Allow editing a mesh asset other components in the level also use (default false). |

### cleanup_set_nanite

**Set mesh Nanite**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Turn Nanite on or off for the static mesh assets of the target actors (converted CAD meshes) and rebuild them. Useful for large merged plans; not for translucent or masked materials on older engines. Only project assets (/Game/) not shared with other components are changed unless allowSharedAssets. Unsaved until the user saves.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Static mesh actors: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | true turns Nanite on for the meshes, false off. |
| `allowSharedAssets` | boolean |  | Allow editing a mesh asset other components in the level also use (default false). |

### cleanup_set_pivot

**Set actor pivots**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Move actors' pivots (to their bounds centre, bottom centre, the world origin or a point) without moving their geometry. Imported splines all have their pivot at the origin; set it to the bounds centre before moving or instancing them. Works on spline actors, generated walls and static mesh actors; for a static mesh it edits the mesh asset (project assets only, and only one used by no other component in the level unless allowSharedAssets). One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Actors whose pivot to move: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `mode` | string: `boundsCenter` / `bottomCenter` / `origin` / `point` |  | Where the pivot goes (default boundsCenter). |
| `point` | array |  | For mode point: [x, y, z] in cm. |
| `allowSharedAssets` | boolean |  | Allow editing a static mesh asset other components in the level also use (default false). |

## import

### import_delete_source

**Delete an imported drawing**. **Destructive**: removes data; the assistant should ask you first.

Delete every actor of one imported drawing (splines, generated walls and converted meshes that carry its tag). Destructive: confirm with the user first. It can be undone with Ctrl+Z in the editor while the level is open; converted static mesh assets stay in the Content Browser.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes | The drawing: hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. |

### import_file

**Import a drawing**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Import a .dxf or .json drawing into the open level as spline actors, one per entity, tagged with the source and layer and grouped in the outliner under CAD/<file>/<layer>. Run import_inspect first and agree the units with the user: units are required unless the file declares them. Options: scaleFactor, zHeight (cm), parser settings, include/exclude layers (wildcards), groupByLayer, per-layer materials (used when walls are generated), colours and Z offsets, recenter for far-away coordinates. If the same file was imported before the call fails and says so: pass replaceExisting=true to delete the old actors first (ask the user) or allowDuplicate=true for a second copy. No dialogs open. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | The drawing: a path relative to the project folder, or absolute inside it. |
| `units` | string: `mm` / `cm` / `m` / `in` / `ft` |  | Drawing units. Required unless the file declares them. |
| `scaleFactor` | number |  | Extra scale on top of the units (default 1). |
| `zHeight` | number |  | Height to place the drawing at, in cm (default 0). |
| `tessellationSegments` | integer |  | Segments of a circle, and of each arc however short, 8-128 (default 32). |
| `pointThreshold` | number |  | Splines: samples closer together than this, in drawing units, are dropped (default 1; use less for drawings in metres). |
| `includeLayers` | array of string |  | Only these layers (wildcards allowed); default every layer. |
| `excludeLayers` | array of string |  | Leave these layers out (wildcards allowed). |
| `groupByLayer` | boolean |  | One outliner folder per layer (default true). |
| `layerMaterials` | object |  | Layer name -> material asset path (/Game/...). Walls generated from the layer use it. |
| `layerColors` | object |  | Layer name -> spline colour, "#RRGGBB" or [r,g,b] in 0-1. |
| `layerZOffsets` | object |  | Layer name -> Z offset in cm added to zHeight. |
| `recenter` | string: `none` / `center` / `minCorner` |  | Move the drawing's bounds centre or minimum corner to the origin (default none). |
| `replaceExisting` | boolean |  | Delete actors of a previous import of this file first. |
| `allowDuplicate` | boolean |  | Import alongside a previous import of this file. |
| `focus` | boolean |  | Frame the result in the viewports (default true). |

### import_focus_source

**Frame an imported drawing**. Reads only: never changes anything.

Move the level viewport cameras to frame one imported drawing, optionally selecting its actors for the user. Use viewport_screenshot afterwards to see it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes | The drawing: hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. |
| `select` | boolean |  | Also select its actors in the editor (default false). |

### import_inspect

**Inspect a drawing**. Reads only: never changes anything.

Preflight a .dxf or .json drawing WITHOUT changing the level. Call it before every import_file. Returns: the units the file declares ($INSUNITS) with a confidence and a suggested unit when it declares none; the bounds in drawing units and in cm after scaling; per-layer primitive counts by type (line, polyline, arc, circle, spline, face3d, mesh); layers that will be ignored; DXF entity types that are not imported (text, hatches, block references...); the reader's warnings; and suspicious findings (a huge or tiny extent for the units, coordinates far from the origin). The path must be inside the project folder.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | The drawing: a path relative to the project folder, or absolute inside it. |
| `units` | string: `mm` / `cm` / `m` / `in` / `ft` |  | Units to compute the cm bounds with; default: the declared or suggested ones. |
| `scaleFactor` | number |  | Extra scale on top of the units (default 1). |
| `tessellationSegments` | integer |  | Segments of a circle, and of each arc however short, 8-128 (default 32). |
| `pointThreshold` | number |  | Splines: samples closer together than this, in drawing units, are dropped (default 1; use less for drawings in metres). |

### import_list_sources

**List imported drawings**. Reads only: never changes anything.

List the CAD drawings imported in the open level: per source its hash (the id other tools take as 'source'), display name, file when known, outliner folder, actor count by kind (spline, procedural walls, staticMesh), visibility, layers and bounds in cm.

No arguments.

## layer

### layer_list

**List layers**. Reads only: never changes anything.

List the layers of imported drawings: per layer its source, actor count by kind (spline, procedural walls, staticMesh), spline colour, visibility, mapped material (used by model_generate_walls), actor Z range and bounds in cm. Give 'source' for one drawing; without it every drawing's layers are listed.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string |  | The drawing: hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. |

### layer_list_actors

**List actors of layers**. Reads only: never changes anything.

List the actors of an imported drawing, of some of its layers, or of named layers across every drawing: id (what other tools take in 'actors'), label, kind, layer, folder and optionally bounds. Use it to pick actors for the model_ and cleanup_ tools.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Actors to describe: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `kind` | string: `spline` / `procedural` / `staticMesh` / `other` |  | Only actors of this kind. |
| `withBounds` | boolean |  | Include each actor's bounds in cm (default false). |
| `limit` | integer |  | At most this many actors (default 100, max 1000). |

### layer_set

**Change layers**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Change layers of one imported drawing: show or hide them, set the spline colour, map a material (model_generate_walls uses it for walls from the layer; with applyMaterialToMeshes it is also put on the layer's existing walls and meshes), or move the layer in Z (zOffset relative, baseZ puts the bottom of the layer at a height). Colour, material and moves are one undo step; visibility is an editor display state.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes | The drawing: hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. |
| `layers` | array of string | yes | Layer names (wildcards allowed), from layer_list. |
| `visible` | boolean |  | Show (true) or hide (false) the layers. |
| `color` | string or array |  | Spline colour: "#RRGGBB" or [r, g, b] in 0-1. |
| `material` | string |  | Material asset path (/Game/...) to map to the layers; "" clears the mapping. |
| `applyMaterialToMeshes` | boolean |  | Also put the material on the layers' existing walls and meshes (default true). |
| `zOffset` | number |  | Move the layers up (positive) or down by this many cm. |
| `baseZ` | number |  | Move the layers so the bottom of their bounds is at this height in cm. |

## model

### model_cap_holes

**Cap wall holes**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Close the open boundary loops of generated walls with fan-triangulated caps (tops and bottoms of closed outlines). Use when walls were generated with capHoles false or look hollow from above. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Wall actors: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |

### model_fix_normals

**Fix wall normals**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Make generated walls face outward: in auto mode each wall's faces are tested against its centre and only inside-out walls are flipped (normals and winding); flip mode flips every target. Use it when a screenshot shows walls dark, missing or see-through from outside. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Wall actors: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `mode` | string: `auto` / `flip` |  | auto (default): flip only walls whose faces mostly point inward; flip: flip every target. |

### model_generate_walls

**Generate walls**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Extrude imported spline actors into 3D walls (procedural mesh actors, placed in a Walls subfolder of their layer and tagged with the same source and layer). Target a layer of walls (e.g. source + layers ["A-WALL"]) rather than the whole drawing. Never reads the editor selection. Walls are added each time it runs: do not run it twice on the same splines. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Spline actors to extrude: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `wallHeight` | number |  | Wall height in cm (default 300). |
| `weldThreshold` | number |  | Points closer than this (cm) are welded (default 1). |
| `closeLoops` | boolean |  | Close open paths whose ends meet within weldThreshold (default true). |
| `capHoles` | boolean |  | Cap the top and bottom of closed paths (default true). |
| `reverseNormals` | boolean |  | Build the walls facing the other way (default false). |
| `material` | string |  | Material asset path for walls whose layer has no mapped material. |
| `useLayerMaterials` | boolean |  | Use each layer's mapped material, from layer_set (default true). |

### model_smooth

**Smooth wall normals**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Average the normals of generated walls where faces meet at less than 'angle', so curved walls (from arcs and circles) shade smoothly while corners stay sharp. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Wall actors: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `angle` | number |  | Normals within this angle (degrees, default 60) are averaged; sharper edges stay hard. |

### model_to_static_mesh

**Convert walls to static meshes**. Changes something: the assistant's client may ask you first.

Convert generated walls (procedural meshes) into static mesh assets and static mesh actors in their place, for lighting, collision, Nanite and packaging. Creates assets (an existing asset of the same name is overwritten) that stay unsaved until the user saves. The actor swap is one undo step; the assets are not removed by undo.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Wall actors: actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `assetFolder` | string |  | Content folder for the new static mesh assets (default /Game/CI_StaticMeshes/). |
| `material` | string |  | Material asset path for every converted mesh; default keeps each wall's material. |
| `keepCadTags` | boolean |  | Keep the CAD source and layer tags so layer tools still find them (default true). |
| `keepFolder` | boolean |  | Keep each wall's outliner folder (default true). |

## viewport

### viewport_focus

**Frame in the viewport**. Reads only: never changes anything.

Move the level viewport camera to frame actors, a drawing or layers (default every imported CAD actor), from a fitted, top-down or 3/4 view. Changes only the camera. Follow with viewport_screenshot.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actors` | array of string |  | Actors to frame (default: every imported CAD actor): actor ids (object path, name or label), from layer_list_actors. |
| `source` | string |  | An imported drawing: its hash, display name or file name, from import_list_sources. Alone it targets every actor of the drawing. |
| `layers` | array of string |  | Layer names (wildcards allowed) within 'source', or across every imported drawing when no source is given. |
| `view` | string: `fit` / `top` / `iso` |  | fit (default): frame in every level viewport; top: look straight down (best for plans); iso: a 3/4 view (best for walls). |

### viewport_screenshot

**Screenshot the viewport**. Reads only: never changes anything.

Capture the perspective level viewport as an image you can look at (PNG by default), downscaled to maxWidth. Use it to verify an import, walls, materials or a cleanup before telling the user it worked.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxWidth` | integer |  | Largest width in pixels (default 1280, 256-3840). |
| `format` | string: `png` / `jpeg` |  | png (default) or jpeg (smaller). |
